title: AI/ML Engineer (Data Engineering + AI Focus)
jobDescription:
Data AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Engineering involves the use of algorithms and statistical models to enable systems to analyze data, learn patterns, and make data-driven predictions or decisions without explicit human programming. AI/ML applications leverage vast amounts of data to identify insights, automate processes, and solve complex problems across a wide range of fields, including healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and more. AI/ML processes transform raw data into actionable intelligence, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent solutions. Data AI/ML combines advanced statistical modeling, computational power, and data engineering to build intelligent systems that can learn, adapt, and automate decisions.
AI/ML Engineer (Data Engineering + AI Focus)

A.P. Moller Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers supply chains.

Today, we have more than 180 nationalities represented in our workforce across 131 Countries and this mean, we have elevated level of responsibility to continue to build inclusive workforce that is truly representative of our customers and their customers and our vendor partners too.

The Brief

In this role as an AI/ML Engineer within the Global Data & Analytics (GDA) team, you will build and scale data-intensive AI/ML solutions that power intelligent decision-making across Maersk s supply chain ecosystem.
This role combines strong data engineering foundations with applied AI/ML expertise, enabling the development of robust data pipelines, scalable ML systems, and production-grade AI applications.
You will work on designing reliable data platforms, enabling high-quality data availability, and embedding advanced analytics and AI capabilities into business workflows.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Partner with business, product, and engineering teams to define scalable data and AI/ML solutions aligned with measurable business outcomes.
  • Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and data platforms using Python, Spark/PySpark, and cloud-native services.
  • Develop and deploy end-to-end AI/ML solutions, including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
  • Architect and optimize large-scale data processing systems on cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, and automated retraining.
  • Work with LLMs and Generative AI systems, integrating them into production workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
  • Design and maintain data models (batch and streaming) that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and observability across pipelines and ML systems.
  • Optimize infrastructure and workloads for cost, scalability, and performance, including efficient use of compute and storage.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy solutions using containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews and best practices.
We are looking for:
  • 7+ years of experience across Data Engineering and AI/ML engineering in production environments.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with hands-on expertise in Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing.
  • Deep experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), including services for data engineering, ML, and distributed systems (e.g., Databricks, Synapse, EMR, S3, ADF, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience in building and deploying scalable data pipelines and ML systems.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling (data lakes, lakehouse, warehouse, medallion architecture).
  • Experience with MLOps frameworks (e.g., MLflow) and production model lifecycle management.
  • Practical experience with LLMs / Generative AI applications, including RAG, document processing, or workflow automation.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of system design, scalability, and cost optimization in cloud environments.
  • Experience with data quality, observability, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Ability to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions with measurable impact.
  • Prior experience in logistics, supply chain, or operations is a plus.
  • Experience in simulation, optimization, or operations research is an added advantage.
CORE SKILLS Programming: Writing code to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data, often using languages like Python, R, and SQL. Proficiency Level: Proficient AI & Machine Learning: Creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Using Machine learning (ML), a subset of AI that uses algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data Proficiency Level: Proficient Data Analysis: Inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information, draw conclusions, and support decision-making Proficiency Level: Foundational Machine Learning Pipelines: Using automated workflows that manage the end-to-end process of training and deploying machine learning models. Proficiency Level: Proficient Model Deployment: Making a trained machine learning model available for use in production environments. Proficiency Level: Proficient

SPECIALIZED SKILLS Big Data Technologies: Using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the process of software development, including building, testing, and deploying code Natural Language Processing (NLP): Focusing on the interaction between computers and humans through natural language. Data Architecture: Designing and structuring of data systems, ensuring that data is stored, managed, and utilized efficiently Data Processing Frameworks: Using tools and libraries to process large data sets efficiently, such as Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark. Technical Documentation: Creating and maintaining documentation that explains the functionality, use, and maintenance of software or systems. Deep Learning: Using a subset of machine learning involving neural networks with many layers, used to model complex patterns in data. Statistical Analysis: Collecting and analyzing data to identify patterns and trends, and to make informed decisions. Data Engineering: Designing and building systems for collecting, storing, and analyzing data at scale.

Definition of Proficiency Levels: Foundational: This is the entry level of the skill, typically expected when starting a new role or working with the skill for the first time. You rely on strong manager support, coaching, and training as you build the capability to progress to higher proficiency levels. Proficient: This is the level at which you are considered effective in the skill. You demonstrate more than just functional competence you begin to have a noticeable impact in your role by applying the skill consistently and meaningfully. You require only minimal support, coaching, or training to apply the skill successfully. Advanced: This is the level where you move beyond meeting expectations to actively leading, influencing, and delivering considerable impact across the wider business. You are seen as a role model, demonstrate the skill independently, and require little to no manager support.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Machine Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models, Small Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Agentic AI systems. Required Skills and Experience

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying applications using LLMs or Generative AI models.

  • Experience working in a startup, product organization or customer-facing solution engineering environment.

Education


Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering or a related discipline.

Equivalent hands-on experience with a strong record of delivering production AI solutions will also be considered.

descriptionFromApi:
Sutherland Global Services is seeking a Machine Learning Developer with 4+ years of experience in building high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade ML systems. As an ML Developer, you'll work across the full machine learning lifecycle for the AI components of an existing platform: data collection and preparation, model selection and training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining as data drifts. You'll design and integrate NLP and machine translation components, build the data pipelines that feed them, and collaborate across developers, testers, and subject matter experts to translate business needs into production ML solutions. You'll work across both the setup phase and ongoing support, serving as the focal point for any NLP-driven and GenAI-driven features in the platform.


Responsibilities:

  • Contribute across the full ML lifecycle including data collection, cleaning, preprocessing, model training, deployment, and post-release monitoring.
  • Design and implement machine learning models using appropriate algorithms for natural language processing, machine translation, and document understanding tasks.
  • Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed the models, including ingestion, transformation, and feature preparation.
  • Evaluate model performance using established metrics, monitor for data drift, and retrain or adjust models as production data evolves.
  • Integrate and tune machine translation quality estimation models such as COMET, COMETKiwi, OpenKiwi, or TransQuest to provide segment-level confidence without human reference translations.
  • Integrate adaptive machine translation systems such as ModernMT or equivalent that learn from human post-editor corrections in real time, alongside general neural machine translation providers such as Azure OpenAI, Azure Translator, Google Translate, and DeepL.
  • Apply automatic post-editing techniques and large language model prompting to correct or improve machine translation output where appropriate.
  • Deploy ML models and services into production on Azure and monitor them post-release.
  • Apply sound software engineering practices including object-oriented design, unit-test-driven development, and clear architecture to ML code.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning, NLP, machine translation, and GenAI, and contribute to the team's continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, testers, and subject matter experts to translate business requirements into scalable and efficient ML solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience building production machine learning systems end-to-end, from data preparation through deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with mainstream ML libraries and frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, spaCy, NLTK).
  • Comfort with Jupyter notebooks for experimentation and with regular expressions for text processing.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP techniques and applications, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, sentence splitting, and language modeling.
  • Working understanding of GenAI applications and large language model prompting for production use cases.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Databricks, Airflow, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with machine translation evaluation and quality estimation, including metrics such as BLEU, chrF, METEOR, COMET, and COMETKiwi.
  • Familiarity with adaptive machine translation, transformer-based model fine-tuning, glossary enforcement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Sound software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented design, unit-test-driven development, and architectural judgment.
  • Strong grasp of data structures, data modeling, and SQL for data manipulation and analysis.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain ML concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders including subject matter experts and project managers.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability and a collaborative working style across developers, testers, and SMEs.
  • Experience with Java or C/C++ as a secondary language, automatic post-editing, PyMuPDF or Azure Document Intelligence for document processing, familiarity with localization tools such as Trados, memoQ, XTM, or Phrase, or prior production work on machine translation or virtual agent platforms would be advantageous.

Title: Mid-Level Application Architect / Senior Developer
We are seeking a dynamic Mid-Level Application Architects / Senior Developers with a strong focus on hands-on development and practical solution design. The ideal candidate will have robust experience in Java and/or .NET, and Python, with working knowledge of front-end technologies like React or Angular, and a foundational understanding of AI integration. This role emphasizes active coding, solution implementation, and collaboration across application development, infrastructure, and integration in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to deliver scalable, secure enterprise applications.
Key Responsibilities:
• Hands-On Coding: Actively develop, test, and deploy application-heavy solutions, write clean, efficient code in any of the programming language like Java, .NET, and Python for backend systems, and contributing to front-end development using React or Angular.
• Solution Design: Partner with senior architects to design scalable, cloud-native application architectures, focusing on performance, maintainability, and integration in multi-cloud environments.
• Integration Development: Build and maintain integrations using APIs, microservices, and event-driven patterns (e.g., REST, GraphQL, Kafka, or message queues).
• Multi-Cloud Implementation: Develop and deploy applications across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring portability and optimization for cost and performance.
• AI Integration: Implement practical AI features (e.g., automation, basic analytics) using cloud-based AI services or frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
• Infrastructure Support: Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement containerized solutions (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on use of IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
• Performance & Security Optimization: Ensure applications meet performance and security standards through code reviews, testing, and adherence to best practices.
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into technical implementations, providing hands-on support and mentorship.
• Continuous Learning: Stay updated on full-stack development trends, cloud technologies, and AI advancements to contribute to innovative solutions.

Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development, with at least 2 years in a lead developer or junior architect role focusing on application-heavy systems.
• Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
• Strong proficiency in Java, .NET, and Python for backend development.
• Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or similar.
• Basic exposure to AI/ML integration, such as using cloud AI services (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure AI) or simple ML frameworks.
• Practical experience with integration patterns (e.g., REST APIs, message queues) and microservices architecture.
• Familiarity with infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and IaC (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
• Experience with cloud-native services (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Run).
• Working knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools.
• Understanding of secure coding practices and basic enterprise security standards (e.g., IAM, encryption).

Soft Skills:
• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with a hands-on mindset.
• Clear communication to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to juggle hands-on coding with architectural design contributions.
• Eagerness to learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and cloud technologies.

Education:
• Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Certifications like AWS Certified Developer, Azure Developer Associate, or similar are a plus.

15 years full time education

About the Role

Looking for a hands-on Microsoft Purview Engineer to build, operate, and continuously harden data-protection and compliance controls across a well-resourced Microsoft 365 E5 estate and structured data sources. This is a build-and-run engineering role at the intersection of traditional M365 compliance and emerging AI data security.

You will own end-to-end sensitivity labeling, DLP, retention, and eDiscovery across Microsoft 365 workloads; deploy and operate Data Security Posture Management for AI (DSPM for AI) to govern how sensitive data is exposed to Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs; and drive PII discovery and classification in SQL Server through the Microsoft Purview Data Map. If you can turn a compliance requirement directly into working, policy-as-configuration controls across both unstructured and structured data, with minimal hand-holding this role is for you.


What You'll Do

Information Protection & DLP

Design, deploy, and tune sensitivity labels, label policies, auto-labeling, and encryption across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams. Author and maintain DLP policies (including Endpoint DLP on Intune-managed devices), build and validate SITs, EDM schemas, and trainable classifiers, and reduce false positives through iterative tuning.


Data Lifecycle, Records & eDiscovery

Implement retention labels and policies, disposition-review workflows, and records-management controls aligned to regulatory and legal-hold obligations (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GLBA, SEC/FINRA, or equivalent). Run eDiscovery (Standard & Premium), content search, and legal-hold workflows, supporting Legal and HR teams with collections, exports, and case management.


Insider Risk & Communication Compliance

Configure and triage Insider Risk Management policies in partnership with HR and Legal, and manage Communication Compliance reviews for policy and regulatory requirements.


DSPM for AI AI Data Security

Deploy and operate Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI to discover and monitor how sensitive data is exposed to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, ChatGPT, Claude, and other generative-AI applications. Run oversharing and data-risk assessments, drive remediation through sensitivity labels, access reviews, and SharePoint Advanced Management, configure AI DLP and risky-interaction detection policies, and audit AI prompts and responses producing risk-posture reports for leadership.


Structured Data Discovery & Classification (SQL Server)

Register and scan SQL Server sources (on-premises via self-hosted integration runtime, and Azure SQL) in the Purview Data Map. Configure scan rule sets and schedules, classify PII at the column level, and tune built-in and custom classifiers for personal, financial, and health data. Profile and validate findings directly in SQL Server using T-SQL, bridge structured findings into M365 controls (e.g., EDM schemas that power DLP and auto-labeling), and maintain the data catalog, classifications, and lineage.


Operations, Governance & Automation

Monitor compliance alerts across the Purview portal and Microsoft Defender, maintain Compliance Manager assessments and audit evidence, automate recurring operations via Security & Compliance PowerShell and Microsoft Graph (Security API), and document architecture decisions, runbooks, and change records.

Technical

Senior Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
  • Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
  • Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data

Reliability, evaluation & safety

  • Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
  • Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
  • Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review

Integration & production craft

  • Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
  • Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk
  • Translate ambiguous, high-complexity implementation processes into robust system logic and reusable AI patterns; stay current with advances in agentic systems and translate research into practical engineering decisions

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated depth building and shipping production agentic AI systems — we weigh shipped systems over years in a title
  • Strong, hands-on experience with LangGraph or equivalent agentic orchestration frameworks, including custom orchestration
  • Deep proficiency in Python — clean, testable, production-ready code
  • Experience designing and optimising end-to-end RAG systems: indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and evaluation
  • Daily working proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API) and Claude Code — you use these tools every day, not occasionally
  • Experience building and deploying agents on Azure AI Foundry or an equivalent enterprise cloud AI platform

Understanding of payment regulations, AML, sanctions screening, and compliance frameworks.
Finastra Global PAYplus implementation or product certification is an added advantage.

We are looking for a highly skilled Analytics Engineer / Data Integration Specialist with 5 to 8 years of experience to manage and optimize enterprise data integration workflows supporting our Snowflake data warehouse . The role will take ownership of end-to-end pipeline maintenance, break/fix support, data validation, and data modeling while collaborating closely with internal engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors. This position plays a key role in ensuring reliable data operations and enabling teams to focus on AI and advanced analytics initiatives .

  • Advanced SQL and Snowflake expertise, including data modeling, data shares, and semi-structured data.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling, data validation, QA, and data cleansing .
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , including branching, merging, and code management.
  • Experience with Jira and Agile project workflows.
  • Strong production support and incident management experience in SLA-driven environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting data pipelines and resolving integration issues.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate technical issues for business and technical audiences.

  • Own and lead a critical data platform: Take end-to-end ownership of enterprise data integration and Snowflake operations.
  • Work across teams: Collaborate with engineering, business, technical administration, and external vendor teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Shape processes that improve data quality, pipeline stability, and operational efficiency.
  • Enable AI & advanced analytics: Your work will directly help internal teams transition from operational maintenance toward high-value AI and advanced analytics initiatives .

Job Description
At Impressico, the Personal Assistant to the Technical Director exists to protect the Director s time and attention so that it is spent on the highest-value technical and strategic work. The role owns the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Director s office - calendar, correspondence, meeting preparation and follow-through, travel and logistics - and extends to personal and family coordination where that serves the same objective. The successful candidate will be a trusted, discreet single point of contact for internal leaders, clients and vendors, and will be expected to anticipate what is needed and resolve it before it has to be asked for.
Responsibilities:
  • Own and actively manage the Director s calendar - schedule, sequence and protect time; resolve conflicts; build in preparation, travel and buffer time; keep the week ahead planned and the day ahead confirmed
  • Prepare the Director for every meeting - circulate agendas, assemble briefing notes and background on attendees and topics, collate the relevant documents, and follow up afterwards on minutes, decisions and action items until they are closed
  • Draft, review and manage email and documents on the Director s behalf - triage the inbox, flag what needs attention, prepare replies for approval, and produce clean, well-formatted decks, reports, trackers and meeting notes
  • Schedule meetings and working sessions across internal leadership, delivery teams, clients and vendors, including across time zones, and ensure invites, agendas, rooms and conferencing links are correct
  • Compile and circulate recurring reports and status updates to leadership, initiative stakeholders and clients to agreed timelines, chasing inputs from contributors where required
  • Arrange all travel and logistics for the Director and, where required, family - air, rail and hotel bookings, visas, cabs, itineraries, expense claims and reimbursements - and re-plan quickly when arrangements change at short notice
  • Provide day-to-day office and personal support - meeting rooms and equipment, visitor hosting, meals and refreshments during long working days, courier and documentation errands, appointments, bill payments and similar personal chores as directed
  • Act as the first point of contact for the Director s office; screen and route incoming requests, and maintain professional working relationships with internal leaders, clients, vendors and service providers
  • Maintain the Director s records and trackers - initiative and action-item trackers, contacts, subscriptions, vendor documentation and confidential files - with accuracy and version discipline
  • Anticipate and pre-empt - identify what will be needed next, surface clashes and risks early, and bring a proposed solution rather than only a problem
  • Handle all professional and personal information with absolute confidentiality and discretion
Job Specification
Job Specification
(Mandatory Skills required)
  • 6+ years experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or Secretary to a senior leader (Director / VP / CXO), preferably in an IT services or technology organization
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to correspond independently and professionally with senior internal stakeholders, clients and vendors
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a complex, frequently changing calendar across time zones and to make sound prioritization calls without being told what matters
  • Strong working proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Meet) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • Proven experience in end-to-end travel management - domestic and international bookings, visa processing, itineraries, and expense reporting
  • Disciplined meeting management - agendas, accurate minutes, action tracking and closure follow-up
  • Structured problem solver: able to take an ambiguous instruction, ask the right clarifying questions, and run it to completion with minimal supervision
  • Proactive and highly organized, with a bias for action, ownership of outcomes, and reliable follow-through across many parallel tasks
  • Absolute integrity and discretion in handling confidential professional and personal information
  • Poised, pleasant and service-oriented; comfortable interacting with senior leadership, clients and their offices
  • Willingness to support personal and family-related coordination, and to be reachable outside general shift hours when the situation demands
Optional skills - nice to have
  • Hands-on comfort with AI productivity tools (for example Claude or ChatGPT) for drafting, summarizing and research
  • Familiarity with collaboration tooling such as Slack, Jira / Confluence, Notion or Fireflies meeting transcription
  • Experience with corporate travel and expense portals, vendor onboarding and purchase-order processes
  • Working knowledge of Hindi and/or a regional language in addition to English
Required Key Skills
Executive/personal assistance, calendar inbox management, meeting preparation and minutes, travel and ticketing, business communication (spoken and written English), MS Office and Google Workspace
Optional: exposure to AI productivity tools (Claude / ChatGPT), Slack, Jira / Confluence, Fireflies

Job Summary
About the role. Genzeon has established a dedicated Microsoft Practice and is investing in deepening its strategic partnership with Microsoft. We are seeking an Associate Director of Microsoft Alliance Partnerships to own and grow the alliance end to end.
The Alliance Associate Director is responsible for maximizing the value of Genzeons relationship with Microsoft driving joint go-to-market and co-sell, achieving and maintaining Microsoft Designations and Specializations, growing Azure consumption, managing the full operational backbone of the partnership (Partner Center, incentives, tagging, referrals), and building Genzeons presence on the Microsoft commercial marketplace. Success is measured in partnership status, co-sell pipeline and wins, ACR growth, and the investments and incentives unlocked from Microsoft.


Key Responsibilities
  • Go-to-market co-sell: Define and drive joint go-to-market (GTM) initiatives with Microsoft, aligning Genzeons offerings to Microsofts priorities and solution areas.
  • Go-to-market co-sell: Own the co-sell motion end to end; build and maintain the co-sell solution portfolio, register co-sell-ready offers, manage IP-co-sell and services co-sell, and drive deal referrals in both directions with Microsoft sellers.
  • Go-to-market co-sell: Partner with internal account teams to help close deals by connecting them with the right Microsoft sellers and orchestrating joint pursuit activities including Account planning sessions.
  • Designations, Specializations, ACR: Own the roadmap to achieve and maintain Microsoft Solutions Partner Designations and Specializations, managing partner points, performance, skilling, and audit readiness.
  • Designations, Specializations, ACR: Drive Azure Consumed Revenue (ACR) growth across customers and engagements, tracking consumption and partnering with practice teams to accelerate it.
  • Relationship management: Build and manage relationships with key Microsoft stakeholders, including the Partner Development Manager (PDM), co-sell/partner sales teams, and relevant business-group and field contacts.
  • Relationship management: Develop and maintain the annual partner business plan with Microsoft and run a regular partnership cadence and business reviews.
  • Partnership operations incentives: Manage all partner tagging and attribution (PAL, CPOR, and DPOR) to ensure Genzeon is correctly credited for influence and consumption.
  • Partnership operations incentives: Own Partner Center and Supplier/partner portal administration and hygiene (memberships, users, competencies, compliance).
  • Partnership operations incentives: Track and maximize Microsoft incentives, investments, and funding ensuring Genzeon is tapping every available program (incentives/rebates, MDF/co-op marketing funds, activity-based and consumption-based investments, ECIF and similar deployment/POC funds).
  • Partnership operations incentives: Manage deal referrals, referral pipeline hygiene, and reporting.
  • Marketplace: Prepare and own the Microsoft commercial marketplace solutions roadmap, working with internal practice teams to identify and shape offers.
  • Marketplace: Own publishing of offers on the Microsoft marketplace, including professional services offers and SaaS transactable offers, and manage their lifecycle, private offers, and go-to-market on marketplace.
  • Enablement reporting: Enable internal sales and account teams on how to engage Microsoft, use co-sell, and leverage partnership benefits.
  • Enablement reporting: Maintain a partnership scorecard and report on alliance KPIs co-sell pipeline and wins, ACR, designation/specialization status, incentives earned, and marketplace performance to Genzeon leadership.
  • Enablement reporting: Ensure ongoing compliance with the Microsoft Partner Agreement and program requirements.


Requirements
  • 10-15 years overall, with 5+ years in a Microsoft alliance / partner development / partnerships role at a Microsoft partner or ISV.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Microsoft partner ecosystem: Solutions Partner designations, Specializations, co-sell, and the incentives/investment landscape.
  • Proven, practical experience with Partner Center, partner tagging (PAL, CPOR), and the Microsoft commercial marketplace (publishing professional services and SaaS transactable offers).
  • Demonstrated track record driving ACR / Azure consumption growth and co-sell pipeline and wins.
  • Strong relationship management skills with a network of, or proven ability to build relationships with, Microsoft field, partner, and PDM contacts.
  • Commercial and analytical acumen able to track incentives, model partnership ROI, and report to leadership.
  • Excellent communication, cross-functional orchestration, and stakeholder-management skills.


Highly desirable
  • Existing relationships within Microsofts partner and field organization.
  • Experience taking co-sell-ready and marketplace offers to market, including transactable SaaS.
  • Familiarity with Azure, Azure AI, and ideally healthcare.
  • Experience supporting Specialization audits and designation attainment.

  • To complete training as per the quality matrix targets.
  • To prepare and update the SOPs. To prepare method development and verification report.

  • To perform the work as allocated by Sub-department Manager.

  • To keep the documentation online with analysis.

  • In the absence of Officer, Sub-department Manager will ensure his roles and responsibilities.

  • To communicate project related issues to Sub-department Manager and follow the action plan.

Qualifications
  • Masters (Pharmacy, or equivalent discipline) with 6 to 10 years of experience, or, PhD (computational chemistry, biophysics or equivalent discipline) with 0 to 5 years of experience with computational chemistry, MD simulations, quantum chemical calculations, or related in-silico techniques

  • Trouble shooting of various problems obtain during the product development

Were looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash.   • Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements.
  • Shape the AI Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements-task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants-and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer.
  • Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI.
  • Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features.
  • Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements-cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption-and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives.

About the role:

You will own all content projects with a Unilever brand from brief through delivery - acting as the single point of accountability between Oliver and the Unilever stakeholders. You ll provide day-to-day leadership and creative expertise to the onsite creative team at Unilever, ensuring work meets brand standards, business objectives and delivery timelines while maximizing creative impact and efficiency.

  • Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Unilever marketing, media, e-commerce, legal, and insights teams plus Oliver s internal producers and specialist partners to prioritize and sequence work.
  • Production management: oversee budgets, timelines, briefs, shoot planning, agency vendors and post-production to deliver assets on time and on budget.
  • Quality control governance: implement review gates, asset tracking and approval workflows that satisfy both agency standards and Unilever governance.
  • Performance iteration: use campaign analytics, A/B testing and consumer insights to optimize content and report impact to both Oliver and Unilever stakeholders.
  • Process scaling: recommend and implement improvements to onsite workflows, asset libraries and repurposing strategies to increase speed-to-market and ROI.
  • Represent Oliver: advocate for Oliver s creative approach while adapting to Unilever s operating model and priorities.

What you need to be great in this role:

  • 5+ years content/creative experience in an agency environment with 2+ years in a client-facing lead role.
  • Proven track record managing end-to-end projects for large enterprise/FMCG clients (Unilever experience is a strong plus).
  • Experience working embedded/onsite at a client location and navigating enterprise governance.
  • Strong creative direction across formats: short-form and long-form video, social, digital, ecommerce and email.
  • Production experience - briefing, managing shoots, post-production workflows and vendor relationships.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to run reviews and present to senior client stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CMS, Adobe/Premiere/PXD tools, content calendars, project tools (Asana/Notion) and analytics platforms.
  • Organized, decisive, and comfortable balancing multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.
  • Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies
  • Understanding and knowledge of AI tools is beneficial, but ability to learn and digest benefits and features of AI tools is critical

Preferred

  • Experience with Unilever or other major CPG brands.
  • Background in integrated campaigns that combine paid + organic content.
  • Photography/videography or editorial background.

Success metrics / KPIs

  • On-time and on-budget delivery of Unilever content projects.
  • Client satisfaction / relationship health (CSAT, stakeholder NPS).
  • Creative performance metrics: engagement, watch time, conversion lift attributable to content.
  • Efficiency gains: asset reuse rate, reduced production cycle time.
  • Team health: retention, development and quality of work delivered onsite.

  • Comfortable asking questions and respectfully voicing your opinion in group settings.
  • Comfortable providing and discussing a recommendation after evaluating multiple solutions.
  • Experienced working in a software development environment with a strong focus on backend engineering, API design, and building internal developer platforms.
  • Production-level expertise in object-oriented or scripting languages, with a strong preference for Python or C#.
  • Familiarity with configuration management and infrastructure-as-code tools (such as Ansible or Terraform) to bridge the gap between software and operations.
  • Have a strong knowledge of Linux, Kubernetes, networking, and infrastructure fundamentals in a multi-region microservice architecture environment.
  • Comfortable collaborating within a global team.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub CoPilot (e.g., code generation, infrastructure-as-code suggestions, test generation, issue troubleshooting).
  • Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify failure modes, and apply sound engineering judgment before promoting changes to production.
  • Curious and pragmatic about applying AI to operational problems (reliability, observability, incident response, cost optimization, developer experience) rather than viewing AI as a novelty.
  • Understands the importance of data quality, context, and access controls when using AI in environments with sensitive production data.
  • Interested in continuously learning and adapting as AI tooling and capabilities evolve within the software development lifecycle.

  • Drive development and maintenance of our .NET tenant management tooling and automation.
  • Design and build robust software solutions and APIs to eliminate manual work related to tenant creation, deletion, renaming, migration, and refresh processes.
  • Contribute to best practices and build out tools and frameworks to increase productivity of our Engineering group.
  • Work closely with application development teams and incorporate their feedback to improve developer experience and reduce toil.
  • Present plans and proposals to Engineering Leadership.
  • Lead projects as we execute objectives shared across our Production Engineering team.
  • Provide guidance to less senior engineers.
  • Participate in a 12 hours on, 12 hours off on-call rotation within the Production Engineering team.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate software development, testing, and documentation while ensuring reliability, security, and compliance standards are met.
  • Apply AI techniques to reduce operational toil, such as automated analysis of automation failures.
  • Design and build internal tooling that incorporates AI capabilities when appropriate .

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether youre developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

AS AN AWS SOLUTION ARCHITECT, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:
  • Ensure customer success in building and launching Amazon Connect solutions for NeuraFlash customers
  • Conduct technology assessment and audits to identify the need (from an ROI and Outcomes perspective) to move to CCaaS AWS Connect Platform, improving agent experience and productivity

  • Translate customer requirements into contact center design, leveraging best practices, and other AWS Services

  • Drive best practice contact center design into each and every aspect of solution delivery
  • Effectively manage all aspects of project and customer communications
  • Deliver customer end user training and documentation
  • Exercise independent judgment, and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from senior management
  • Lead vision and strategy discussions with contact center and customer service leadership and management
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Customer-facing contact center experience
  • Experience building integrations across WFM, CRM, and contact center solutions
  • Experience with communications protocols and APIs such as WebRTC and SIP
  • Experience with hands-on Scripting/coding (e.g., python, java, c#, .NET, Node.js)
  • Communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with executives, IT Management, and customers
  • API integration experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Experience with Cloudformation, Contact Flow Design, Lambda Integration, Lex Integration, and Call Center Routing
  • Knowledge of automation tools and frameworks for building, testing, and deploying software, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CodeDeploy
  • Contact Center architecture knowledge
  • Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting
  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture
  • Salesforce knowledge and familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Contact center product knowledge of other platforms (Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio, etc.)
  • Experience with WorkForce Management solutions
  • Experience working with outbound dialers and campaign management
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification
  • AWS Developer Associate Certification or Professional
  • AWS Solution Architect Certification or Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

What s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture
  • Remote In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or youre one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and dont mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport We know that a perfect 9-5 isn t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

    • Time Series Forecasting / Time Series Modeling

    • Model validation and error analysis
    • Feature selection / importance

    • Experimentation and hypothesis-driven analysis

  • Experience building clean, modular, and production-friendly code

  • Ability to independently convert business problems into:
    • Analytical frameworks
    • Model approaches
    • Features / assumptions
    • Metrics and success criteria

  • Basic understanding of:
    • Docker / containers

  • Challenge product designs where risks are not adequately addressed and help teams develop workable alternatives.

Product Assurance

  • Review existing products and processes for compliance gaps and emerging risks.
  • Assess the impact of new markets, products, payment flows and material changes.
  • Drive remediation of identified gaps and track controls through implementation.
  • Identify systemic risks and reusable solutions across products rather than solving issues individually.
  • Contribute to periodic Product Compliance health reviews and ongoing oversight.

Regulatory Intelligence

  • Monitor regulatory developments relevant to Niums products and markets.
  • Assess how regulatory changes impact product design, processes and controls.
  • Develop reusable jurisdictional guidance, playbooks and compliance knowledge.
  • Partner with regional Compliance and MLRO teams to translate local requirements into scalable product solutions.

AI Automation

  • Identify opportunities to use technology and AI to make Product Compliance more scalable and effective.
  • Help develop AI-assisted compliance workflows and knowledge-management capabilities.
  • Identify repetitive compliance activities that can be automated.
  • Contribute to initiatives such as Compliance Copilot and other Product Compliance tooling.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, structured problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

  • Cross-border payments and remittances

  • Cards and card issuing

  • Build reusable Product Compliance frameworks, playbooks and knowledge assets.

This is not a traditional compliance operations or investigations role.

Experience in AML, KYC/KYB, sanctions or financial crime is valuable, but we are not primarily looking for someone whose experience has been limited to:

  • AML investigations or transaction monitoring
  • KYC/KYB operations or document verification
  • Sanctions screening operations
  • Case management
  • Regulatory reporting execution

EVOCS is looking for a Sales Executive with 57 years of B2B sales experience to drive new-business generation across a defined India territory while also running structured outbound calling into APAC global regions. This is a hybrid, high-activity role for someone who genuinely enjoys being on the field — meeting CXOs and business leaders face-to-face — as well as building relationships over the phone with decision-makers across time zones. You'll need a track record you can point to: quota carried, quota achieved, and clear, quantifiable revenue you personally generated for your previous employer(s). Strong personal connect with senior stakeholders and excellent communication skills (written and verbal) are non-negotiable, since this role spans in-person enterprise selling in India and remote relationship-building across APAC.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own new-business generation — Drive end-to-end pipeline generation for your territory (Mumbai or Delhi NCR) and for assigned APAC accounts — from prospecting through qualified opportunity handoff.
  • Be on the field, most of the time — Spend the majority of your week meeting CXOs, IT/procurement heads and business leaders face-to-face in your territory to understand their priorities and position EVOCS's offerings.
  • Run structured calling into APAC — Own a disciplined outbound and account-management calling motion into APAC global regions (e.g., Singapore, Australia, Southeast Asia, Japan), building pipeline and relationships with prospects and decision-makers you may never meet in person.
  • Pitch the full portfolio — Identify Mid and Large size enterprises (500Cr+ turnover and 1,000+ employee base) and position EVOCS's seven practice areas and MASP, tailoring the pitch to each prospect's priorities and maturity.
  • Qualify and target the right accounts — Identify digital/AI product companies spending 5 crore+ a year on product maintenance as priority MASP targets, alongside enterprise accounts across the other practice areas.
  • Build personal connect with stakeholders — Develop genuine, lasting relationships with CXOs, IT/procurement heads and business leaders — going beyond transactional selling to become a trusted point of contact they return to.
  • Demonstrate revenue impact — Track and report the revenue you personally generate for EVOCS, using bookings/closed revenue as the core, quantifiable measure of your success in the role.
  • Manage a disciplined pipeline — Build and maintain a personal pipeline against a defined opportunity-generation target, with consistent CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting across both field and APAC calling activity.
  • Partner with delivery — Work closely with EVOCS's practice leads and solution teams to shape proposals, size engagements and run a consultative, multi-stakeholder sales process.
  • Own the sales cycle — Carry each opportunity through first meeting/call, proposal coordination, negotiation and closure, with scoping and pricing support from delivery leadership.
  • Build market presence — Represent EVOCS at industry events, client forums and networking opportunities to build visibility and a referral network in your territory and across APAC.
  • Report on performance — Provide regular, honest reporting on pipeline health, activity levels, revenue generated and forecast accuracy to sales leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL SELL

  • Seven practice areas — Strategy & Transformation Advisory, Data Center & Cloud Lifecycle, Cloud & IT Managed Services, Cybersecurity & Managed Security, Enterprise Applications & Supply Chain, AI/Data & Digital Products, and Talent & Workforce Solutions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience — 5–7 years of B2B/enterprise sales experience selling Software, Digital Products, IT/Managed Services (MSP), or Staffing solutions, with a track record of carrying and achieving a quota.
  • Proven revenue generation — Able to clearly quantify the revenue you've personally generated for previous employers (e.g., annual bookings, quota attainment %, largest deals closed) — this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.
  • Field + APAC experience — Demonstrated comfort operating a hybrid sales motion — majority in-person field selling in your home territory, combined with structured outbound/relationship calling into APAC or other global regions.
  • CXO selling — Demonstrated experience selling to CXOs and senior decision-makers — comfortable opening doors cold and building relationships from scratch, in person and over the phone.
  • Excellent communication skills — Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to build instant rapport, sustain long-term personal connect with senior stakeholders, and communicate confidently across cultures and time zones — this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.
  • A true field mindset — Genuinely comfortable spending most of the week meeting clients in person across the assigned city/region, with willingness to travel within and beyond the territory as needed.
  • Self-driven — Able to operate with minimal supervision — this role is built for someone who builds their own pipeline rather than waiting for leads.
  • Consultative selling — Strong presentation and consultative-selling skills — able to translate a broad, multi-practice portfolio into a relevant pitch for each prospect.
  • Enterprise sales cycles — Comfortable navigating longer, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, typically 2–6+ months.
  • Education — Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred but not mandatory.
  • Location & network — Based in (or willing to relocate to) Mumbai or Delhi NCR, with an existing network in the local enterprise/CXO community a strong plus; flexibility to align working hours with APAC time zones for calling activity.

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
  • Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
  • Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data

Reliability, evaluation & safety

  • Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
  • Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
  • Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review

Integration & production craft

  • Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
  • Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk
  • Translate ambiguous, high-complexity implementation processes into robust system logic and reusable AI patterns; stay current with advances in agentic systems and translate research into practical engineering decisions

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated depth building and shipping production agentic AI systems — we weigh shipped systems over years in a title
  • Strong, hands-on experience with LangGraph or equivalent agentic orchestration frameworks, including custom orchestration

title: AI Automation Test Engineer - Playwright (Web & Mobile)
jobDescription:
Job Summary


We are seeking an AI Automation Test Engineer with strong hands-on Playwright expertise to build, scale, and maintain intelligent test automation for web and mobile applications. This role has a specific mandate: migrate and modernise existing Java-based Selenium test suites to Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript), while embedding AI-assisted techniques (AI-generated test cases, self-healing locators, MCP-enabled tooling, LLM-based test data and failure triage) into the day-to-day QA workflow.

The ideal candidate has already led or contributed materially to a Java Selenium Playwright migration, can quantify the outcome (execution time, flakiness, maintenance effort), and is comfortable using AI tooling as a force multiplier rather than a novelty.


Role & responsibilities


Playwright Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end automation suites using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
  • Build scalable framework architecture Page Object Model / fixtures, reusable components, config-driven environments, parallel and sharded execution.
  • Implement API testing within Playwright (request context) alongside UI coverage, plus Postman/Newman where required.
  • Use Playwright's tracing, video, screenshot, and network interception/mocking capabilities to make failures diagnosable on the first pass.
  • Implement visual regression and accessibility checks (e.g. Playwright snapshots, axe-core integration).

Selenium Playwright Migration

  • Audit the existing Java-based Selenium suites: assess coverage, redundancy, flakiness, and business criticality to define migration scope and sequencing.
  • Define the migration strategy and roadmap wave planning, coexistence approach, and criteria for rewrite vs. retire vs. defer.
  • Convert Java Selenium test scripts, locator strategies, waits, and utilities into TypeScript/JavaScript Playwright idioms (auto-waiting, web-first assertions, locators over raw selectors) a cross-language rewrite, not a line-by-line port.
  • Re-map Java-side supporting layers (TestNG/JUnit structures, Maven/Gradle build config, custom utilities, reporting hooks) to their Playwright/Node equivalents.
  • Run both suites in parallel during transition and reconcile results to prove functional equivalence before Selenium decommissioning.
  • Report migration KPIs: coverage parity, execution time reduction, flakiness rate, maintenance effort saved.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate test case generation, test data synthesis, and script scaffolding from requirements, user stories, or Figma designs.
  • Work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and AI agent frameworks to enable AI-driven test execution, exploration, and reporting.
  • Implement self-healing locators and AI-assisted failure triage to reduce false positives and manual analysis time.
  • Apply AI to log/defect clustering, root-cause suggestion, and risk-based regression selection.
  • Critically validate all AI-generated output — accountability for correctness stays with the engineer.

Mobile Automation

  • Automate Android and iOS applications using Appium (and Playwright for mobile web / responsive viewports).
  • Execute across real devices, emulators/simulators, and cloud device farms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest).
  • Validate compatibility across OS versions, screen sizes, and form factors; ensure Google Play and Apple App Store guideline compliance.

CI/CD, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI) with quality gates and scheduled regression runs.
  • Containerise execution (Docker) and manage parallel/grid execution for speed at scale.
  • Publish actionable reporting and QA metrics — pass rate, flakiness, coverage, defect leakage, mean time to detect.
  • Manage defects end-to-end in Jira; drive clear reproduction steps and fast developer turnaround.
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, and QA reviews in an Agile/Scrum environment; contribute to shift-left and test-first practices.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers on Playwright and AI-assisted testing practices.


Preferred candidate profile


  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related field.
  • 5 to 7 years of overall test automation experience, including at least 2 years hands-on Playwright in a production delivery context.
  • Demonstrable experience migrating test scripts from Java Selenium to Playwright — able to walk through scope, approach, pitfalls, and measured outcomes.
  • Strong programming ability in TypeScript/JavaScript, with a solid grasp of async/await patterns, Node tooling, and npm ecosystem.
  • Working proficiency in Java — sufficient to read, interpret, and refactor existing Selenium/TestNG codebases during migration.
  • Deep understanding of Selenium WebDriver — architecture, explicit/implicit waits, grid, and its limitations relative to Playwright.
  • Practical experience applying AI/LLM tools to testing (test generation, script authoring, triage, self-healing) — including awareness of their failure modes.
  • Exposure to MCP servers or comparable AI-agent tooling for test execution or orchestration.
  • API testing proficiency — REST, JSON schema validation, auth flows, Postman.
  • Mobile automation with Appium; working knowledge of Android Studio and Xcode basics.
  • Git-based workflows, code review discipline, and CI/CD pipeline experience.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Playwright component testing; contract testing (Pact).
  • Performance testing — k6, JMeter, Gatling; Lighthouse for web performance.
  • Accessibility testing to WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 standards.
  • Cloud platform familiarity (Azure, AWS, GCP) and observability tooling.
  • Test management integration (Zephyr, Xray, TestRail) and BDD (Cucumber, Playwright-BDD).
  • Security testing basics (OWASP Top 10 awareness).
  • ISTQB certification or equivalent.

descriptionFromApi:
Our Clients Digital Finance IT is building an AI-enablement layer on top of our enterprise data platform to enable business users across Finance to interact with governed data in natural language. We're hiring a Data Enablement Engineer to design, build, and operate the trusted datasets, semantic models, and embedded AI experiences that make this possible.

This is a data platform engineering role, not a data science or model-building role. You will spend your time engineering the data foundation that makes AI reliable - semantic layers, governed data products, and embedded natural-language analytics - not training models.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build AI-ready data products on Snowflake and/or Databricks - trusted datasets with well-defined business semantics, KPIs, hierarchies, and business glossary alignment
  • Implement semantic layers and governed datasets that support both traditional BI consumption and natural-language querying by business users
  • Deploy and operate Snowflake Cortex capabilities (Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, Cortex LLM Functions) and/or Databricks Genie spaces with Unity Catalog, tuning them for accuracy, adoption, and business relevance
  • Build RAG pipelines and conversational analytics applications grounded in governed enterprise data - including Streamlit or Databricks Apps that let business users query data without writing SQL
  • Engineer robust ETL/ELT pipelines (dbt, Airflow, Snowpark, PySpark) that produce and maintain the trusted data these AI experiences depend on
  • Implement data governance - RBAC, row/column-level security, masking, lineage, auditability, catalog and metadata management - in a regulated pharma environment
  • Optimize cost and performance on both the data platform side (warehouse sizing, cluster tuning, query optimization) and the AI side (token usage, caching, model routing)
  • Partner with Finance business stakeholders to translate domain requirements into semantic models and governed data products they can trust

Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on data engineering on cloud data platforms - Snowflake and/or Databricks demonstrated in real project delivery, not skill-list-only
  • Direct hands-on experience with either Snowflake Cortex or Databricks Genie - you have built, configured, and tuned these in production or advanced pilots, with specific reference to the flavors used (Cortex Analyst / Search / Agents / LLM Functions, or Genie spaces with semantic models)
  • Semantic layer / trusted data product delivery - you have built governed datasets that business users can rely on, with KPI definitions, hierarchies, and business glossary alignment
  • dbt, PySpark, Snowpark, SQL, Python - strong across the modern data stack
  • Orchestration with Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or equivalent
  • Data governance in regulated environments - RBAC, RLS, masking, lineage, auditability
  • Experience integrating structured and unstructured data (PDFs, SharePoint/Teams content, enterprise knowledge sources) into AI-enablement workflows

Nice to Have

  • Pharma, life sciences, or regulated financial services domain experience
  • Veeva CRM, IQVIA, SAP, or clinical data source integration
  • Streamlit or Databricks Apps for business-facing analytics
  • SnowPro Advanced or Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification
  • LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent RAG frameworks
  • Cost optimization on both compute (warehouse/cluster) and LLM (tokens/caching/routing) dimensions

What We're Not Looking For

  • Data Scientists - this role is not model training, fine-tuning, LoRA/RLHF, or ML research
  • Pure Data Engineers who list Cortex or Genie as a skill but havent shipped it in production
  • AI/GenAI engineers whose center of gravity is LangChain agents or RAG-over-documents, without a strong governed data platform foundation
  • Computer vision, NLP model builders, or multi-agent orchestration specialists - wrong shape for this role
