Job Description

We are looking for a Forward Deployment Engineer - Agentic AI to design, build, deploy, and continuously improve production-grade AI agents within enterprise client environments.

This role combines AI Engineering, software engineering, context engineering, agent evaluation, and client-facing solution delivery. You will work directly with client teams to understand business problems, design agentic solutions, integrate agents with enterprise systems and tools, and ensure that agents are reliable, measurable, secure, and production-ready.

The ideal candidate is someone who can move beyond building AI prototypes and can take an agentic solution from business problem architecture development deployment evaluation continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Agentic AI Engineering

  • Design and develop LLM-powered agents using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar AI coding agents that are capable of reasoning, planning, using tools, and executing complex multi-step workflows.
  • Build autonomous and semi-autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent technologies.
  • Implement agent planning, task decomposition, tool selection, execution, observation, retry, and validation workflows.
  • Build multi-agent systems where specialized agents collaborate to complete complex business processes.
  • Integrate agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, and business workflows.

Context Engineering

  • Design and implement context engineering strategies that provide agents with the right information, instructions, business rules, application state, and tool context at the right time.
  • Build and integrate Context APIs, RAG, memory/state management, structured context, and dynamic context retrieval where appropriate.
  • Optimize context to improve agent accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Design mechanisms to prevent irrelevant or excessive context from degrading agent performance.
  • Apply context engineering principles across real-world enterprise workflows and client environments.

Agent Harness Engineering

  • Design and implement agent harnesses that control state, tool access, permissions, guardrails, retries, recovery, validation, and execution.
  • Build human-in-the-loop workflows for actions requiring approval or oversight.
  • Implement secure tool execution and appropriate authentication and authorization controls.
  • Develop verification mechanisms that allow agents to validate whether an action or task was successfully completed.
  • Integrate agentic workflows with MCP and other enterprise tool protocols.

MCP & Enterprise Integration

  • Develop and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools.
  • Connect agents with enterprise systems including databases, APIs, Git/GitHub, Slack, Jira, Artifactory, CRM platforms, and other business applications.
  • Build reusable tools that allow agents to take actions, rather than simply generate responses.
  • Design secure and scalable integration patterns for enterprise AI agents.

Agent Evaluation & Quality

  • Design and implement comprehensive agent evaluation frameworks to measure task completion, accuracy, reliability, tool usage, and business outcomes.
  • Develop evaluation datasets and automated test suites for agentic workflows.
  • Implement LLM-as-a-Judge alongside deterministic validation and business-rule-based evaluation.
  • Evaluate agent planning, tool selection, tool-call accuracy, response quality, hallucination, and task completion.
  • Establish regression testing to identify changes in agent performance as models, prompts, tools, or context evolve.
  • Develop monitoring and observability capabilities for production agent behavior.

Production AI Engineering

  • Build production-grade AI services using Python, FastAPI, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Deploy AI agents within client cloud and enterprise environments.
  • Build scalable architectures for concurrent users, long-running workflows, and complex agent execution.
  • Implement caching, asynchronous processing, parallel execution, model optimization, and cost controls.
  • Integrate AI applications with Git, CI/CD, Docker, cloud platforms, logging, monitoring, tracing, and observability systems.

Forward Deployment & Client Engagement

  • Work directly with client teams to understand business problems, technical environments, data, workflows, and constraints.
  • Translate business requirements into practical AI and agentic solutions.
  • Work alongside client engineering, data, product, and business teams to deploy solutions within their existing technology ecosystem.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and continuously iterate based on client feedback and real-world agent performance.
  • Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, limitations, and AI-generated insights effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of outcomes from initial discovery through production deployment and adoption.

Business Impact & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities where agentic AI can automate complex workflows, improve decision-making, reduce manual effort, or enhance customer and employee experiences.
  • Measure the business impact of deployed AI solutions.
  • Continuously improve agents based on evaluation results, production telemetry, user feedback, and changing business requirements.
  • Help convert successful AI concepts into repeatable, scalable enterprise solutions. Qualifications

Skills Required

  • 6-15 years of experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with hands-on experience building and deploying production AI solutions.
  • Strong Python development skills with experience building APIs and AI services using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered agentic applications, including multi-step workflows, tool calling, planning, task decomposition, and state management.
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and integrating agents with enterprise tools, APIs, databases, and applications.
  • Strong experience with context engineering, including context APIs, application state, memory, RAG, dynamic context retrieval, agent instructions, and context optimization.
  • Experience with agent harness engineering, including permissions, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, validation, and automated verification.
  • Experience designing and implementing agent evaluation frameworks, including task-level evaluation, tool-call evaluation, regression testing, LLM-as-a-Judge, and production monitoring.
  • Strong software engineering experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, APIs, SQL/databases, cloud platforms, observability, and production deployment.
  • Strong understanding of LLM performance, hallucination mitigation, context windows, token usage, latency, caching, model selection, and cost optimization.
  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, reranking, and grounding is highly desirable.
  • Experience with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar AI coding agents, including repository context engineering, agent instructions, automated testing, and verification, is highly desirable.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to work directly with enterprise stakeholders and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to take AI solutions from prototype to production and deliver measurable business impact.

jobDescription:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Product
Oktas Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier-0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.
The Team
The Enablement team is at the core of expanding Auth0's capabilities for B2B customers, enabling seamless and automated user lifecycle management at a massive scale. We build and own the critical features that enterprises rely on to connect their identity sources to Auth0, including Enterprise APIs and our powerful self-service capabilities.
Our work is highly impactful, helping customers automate the creation, updating, and deactivation of users. This is a cornerstone for B2B SaaS applications that need to efficiently manage access for their own customers and partners. We work with NodeJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and React to build these highly available and scalable services.
What youll be doing:
  • Collaborate with engineers both inside and outside the team to design and deliver powerful new APIs and features for our B2B Customers.
  • Drive technical improvements to our codebase and architecture, ensuring our systems are highly reliable, maintainable, and scalable.
  • Mentor and coach other engineers on sound engineering practices and testing.
  • Work closely with your team, the Product Manager, and the Product Designer to define the look, feel, and functionality of new features and review customer feedback.
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation to ensure we offer our customers the best availability for our services.
What youll bring to the role:
  • 5+ years of experience working on large-scale systems or services.
  • Previous experience using Node.js (TypeScript or JavaScript) to build backend services and create and maintain public or internal APIs.
  • You have worked on full-stack applications in the past; while this is a backend-focused role, a portion of our work involves React, and your familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases.
  • You are a good communicator and mentor who enjoys sharing knowledge and helping the team grow.
  • You work autonomously but know when to seek help from your team members.
  • Experience with containerisation (Docker) and cloud environments (AWS and/or Azure preferred).

Job Description
The Opportunity:
At Flywire, security isn t a checkbox-it s a foundational pillar of how we build. We are looking for a high-impact Senior Security Engineer I, Application Security to act as a technical visionary, bridging the gap between robust defense and rapid innovation. We expect this role to be able to blend traditional security architecture with new technologies like AI-driven automation.
Key Responsibilities
  • AI-Driven Security Automation: Design, prompt-engineer, and deploy automated security review workflows, using for example Claude or other LLM APIs to perform real-time code analysis and architectural reviews within our CI/CD environment.
  • Security Design Architecture: Lead secure design reviews and advanced threat modeling for our complex payment systems and AI integrated applications.
  • Engineering Collaboration Leadership: Act as a technical bridge between Security and Engineering teams. Collaborate frequently with different engineering teams to identify and address security issues.
  • Advanced Full-Stack Reviews: Oversee deep-dive technical reviews, moving beyond basic scans to perform source code audits and live application testing on high-risk features.
  • Automation SDLC: Contribute and take ownership for the automated security controls we are building and take an active part in every aspect of the secure software development lifecycle (S-SDLC).
  • Mentorship Guidance: Provide hands-on remediation guidance and mentor junior security or software engineers, also members of Product teams, on both traditional exploits and emerging AI-specific vulnerabilities. Qualifications
Heres what we are looking for:
Experience Mindset
  • 5+ years in Application Security. Proven experience performing web application penetration tests and vulnerability research. Skills in source code auditing, product assessments and interaction with product teams, and also experience with development of security tools are essential.
  • Automation First: A passion for replacing manual, repetitive tasks with intelligent, automated scripts and AI workflows.
  • AI LLM Proficiency
  • Prompt Engineering for Security : Demonstrated ability to use tools like Claude for security-specific tasks like code summarization, vulnerability detection, and automated fix generation.
  • AI Pipeline Integration : Experience building custom tools or wrappers that leverage LLMs to analyze pull requests and provide context-aware security feedback.
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs : Deep practical knowledge of defending against Prompt Injection, Insecure Output Handling, and Model Inversion.
Technical Proficiencies
  • Full-Stack Depth : experience with Python, Ruby on Rails, Java and modern web dev (JavaScript, Node.js, etc.).
  • Cloud DevOps : Good knowledge of AWS or similar cloud environments, containerization (Docker), and building/maintaining GitLab CI pipelines.
  • Security Tooling: Advanced experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools, and more importantly, the ability to tune them to eliminate noise.
  • Crypto Auth: Deep understanding of applied cryptography, OAuth2, SAML, and SSO implementations.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strategic Communication: Ability to translate complex AI-generated findings into actionable business risks for stakeholders.
Empathy-Driven Security: A collaborative approach that treats developers and product teams as partners, focusing on enablement rather than friction.

Compliance Standards
  • Practical experience aligning technical controls with standards like SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and emerging AI-governance frameworks.

As a Technical Architect, Data & AI focused on Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) and Agentforce, you will be responsible for owning the end-to-end technical solution that turns unified customer data into intelligent, AI-powered experiences for our clients. Youll have the opportunity to make significant contributions to our success by working with the rest of our talented AI and Data team to delight customers.

This position is focused on architecting and executing technical solutions across the Data 360 and Agentforce platform-designing scalable data models, identity resolution strategies, real-time activation patterns, and the agentic solutions built on top of them.

  • Lead and own the technical solution design across Data 360 and Agentforce-including data streams, DLOs, DMOs, identity resolution, calculated insights, segments, real-time activation, and the agent topics, instructions, and actions that consume that data.
  • Design scalable and secure data architectures on Salesforce Data 360-defining ingestion patterns, harmonization, identity resolution rules, and zero-copy / data federation strategies.
  • Deep dive into the limits and boundaries of Data 360 and Agentforce, finding novel solutions to drive business outcomes.
  • Architect RAG and Generative AI solutions leveraging Unstructured DMOs, Retrievers, Search Indexes, and Document Processing, applying RAG best practices.
  • Collaborate with customers, Project Managers, Solution Architects, Developers, and UX Designers to translate business needs into well-architected solutions.
  • Oversee and contribute to all stages of the project lifecycle-from initial design through development, testing, and final deployment.
  • Define integration frameworks and reference architectures connecting Data 360, MuleSoft, enterprise data warehouses, and other systems using real-time and batch patterns.
  • Establish DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices for data and AI solutions.
  • Coach and mentor developers and junior architects, and follow and understand new Salesforce products and technical capabilities.

  • 6+ years of experience in application, data, or software development and architecture
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Salesforce Platform in a development or architecture role
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience architecting and implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud)-data streams, DLOs, DMOs, identity resolution, calculated insights, and activation
  • Proficiency in SQL and Apex, with exposure or working knowledge of modern coding languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java)
  • Experience designing data integration patterns across enterprise systems (MuleSoft, ETL/ELT tooling, data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
  • Understanding of data modeling, governance, security, and privacy best practices
  • Experience with source control, branching/pull request strategies, and familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps principles
  • Strong communication skills; the ability to convey complex technical details to all audiences
Preferred Skills
  • Hands-on experience with Agentforce or other Generative AI / agentic platforms
  • Experience building RAG solutions with Unstructured DMOs, Retrievers, and Search Indexes
  • Salesforce certifications, preferably Data Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Agentforce Specialist
  • Experience defining robust testing approaches for data and GenAI solutions

descriptionFromApi:
Role: DevOps Engineer
Location: Indore, Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru
Experience: 5-10 yrs
Key Skills: Kubernetes, Go, Python, CI/CD, Helm, Linux, Networking, Git, Shell, DevSecOps, Cloud, VMware


InfoBeans Technologies is seeking a hands-on DevOps or Platform Engineer to manage Kubernetes environments, build production-quality automation in Go or Python, and take full ownership of CI/CD pipelines. In this role, you will identify operational challenges, automate solutions, and troubleshoot complex infrastructure, container, and deployment issues across distributed environments.

What will your role look like

- Take full ownership of CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
- Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Kubernetes environments, including unhealthy pods and deployment failures.
- Develop production-quality Go or Python automation scripts to replace repetitive operational or testing tasks.
- Work with Helm charts, Kubernetes Operators, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), containers, and registries.
- Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, code, and container issues across cloud and distributed systems.

Why you will love this role

- Work in a collaborative culture focused on continuous automation and cutting-edge platform technologies.
- Enjoy opportunities to work with high-impact, distributed systems across cloud, hybrid, and bare-metal environments.
- Thrive in an environment that values high autonomy, problem ownership, and engineering excellence.
- Enhance your skill set with advanced exposure to Kubernetes storage, observability, and DevSecOps frameworks.

We would like you to bring along

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) certification.
- Strong proficiency in Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting.
- Solid experience writing production-grade Go or Python code for automation.
- Hands-on expertise with Linux, networking fundamentals, Git, and shell scripting.
- Familiarity with Cloud platforms, VMware, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible), and DevSecOps practices.

About us

InfoBeans, founded in 2000, is a publicly listed company on the NSE & BSE in India, specializing in AI-first software development and implementation for enterprise clients to solve complex business challenges. We strive to deliver value-accretive services over the long term, working as an extension of our clients teams.

We are 1700+ members across our offices in India, the USA, Europe, and the Middle East. We believe that InfoBeans is our team s second home and work hard every day to build a culture that fosters collaboration and excellence. InfoBeans Foundation, our CSR arm, helps underprivileged sections of society become employable through our free one-year training programs.

Creating WOW! is not just a tagline for us; it s our religion!

Sr Network Test Engineer - Data Center Fabrics
This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
What you ll do:
  • Design, build, and execute test plans for functional/feature validation, customer use cases, and proof-of-concept engagements on data center switching platforms.
  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans to validate Junos/Sonic functionality on Broadcom-based switching platforms.
  • Replicate customer network architectures in the lab, including multi-stage IP Clos fabrics (3-stage, 5-stage, and 7-stage spine-leaf designs).
  • Perform functional, interoperability, scale, and convergence testing of BGP-based underlays and EVPN-VXLAN overlays.
  • Test AI/ML data center fabric use cases - RoCEv2 traffic profiles, lossless Ethernet behavior (PFC/ECN/DCQCN tuning), congestion management, and load-balancing efficiency across GPU back-end fabrics.
  • Validate IPv4 and IPv6 unicast/multicast forwarding, dual-stack designs, and IPv6-only fabric use cases.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and overlay protocols: BGP (eBGP/iBGP underlay designs, route reflectors, route policies, communities, and multipath); EVPN route types; VXLAN bridging and routing (CRB/ERB); multihoming (ESI-LAG); and DCI scenarios.
  • Use traffic generators (e.g., Ixia/Keysight, Spirent) to build traffic profiles, measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and convergence times.
  • Identify, isolate, and document software defects; work with development teams to reproduce issues and verify fixes.
  • Author clear, detailed test plans, test reports, and PoC summary documents for internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Automate repetitive test workflows using Python, pytest, Ansible, or similar frameworks where applicable.
  • Present test findings and demonstrations to customers during PoC reviews and technical deep-dives.
  • Test and verify SAI (Switch Abstraction Interface) integration and ASIC driver behavior
  • Validate optical modules across various speeds, breakout configurations, and transceiver management protocols.
  • Contributions to SONiC or other open-source networking projects (highly valued)

  • Strong understanding of IPCLOS fabric architecture, AI/ML fabric, BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, and IPv6 networking protocols.
  • A testing duty for AI/ML fabric use cases, including RoCEv2 traffic profiles and PFC/ECN/DCQCN tuning validation.
  • Strong hands-on CLI experience with at least one major data center NOS (e.g., Junos, NX-OS, EOS, SONiC).
  • Strong hands-on traffic generation and analysis tools (Ixia/Keysight IxNetwork, Spirent TestCenter, or open-source equivalents).
  • Strong troubleshooting methodology - able to isolate issues across the control plane, data plane, and optics/physical layer.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and documentation skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to produce customer-facing test reports, and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with SONiC NOS and SAI-based architectures (preferred)
  • Experience with traffic generators like Spirent or IxNetwork
  • Familiarity with Broadcom SDKs such as SDKLT or OpenNSL (preferred)
  • Solid grasp of SONiC architecture: SAI, FRR, Redis DB, Docker, Minigraph (preferred)
  • Exposure to telemetry, gNMI, OpenConfig, and YANG/Netconf/REST API testing
  • Proficient with Git, Jenkins, Docker, and lab-based testbed environments
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience running customer PoC labs or certification / qualification / functional testing for a network equipment vendor, hyperscaler, or large enterprise.
  • Hands-on experience with AI fabric benchmarking and validation tools (e.g., NCCL tests, perftest/ib_write_bw for RoCE, collective communication workload simulation)
  • Familiarity with emerging standards such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC); exposure to InfiniBand is a plus.
  • Familiarity with 100G/400G/800G optics (LR4, CWDM4, DR4, FR4), transceiver qualification, and high-density fixed/modular platforms.
  • Scripting and automation experience - Python, pytest, Robot Framework, Ansible, or REST/NETCONF/gNMI-based automation.
  • Exposure to telemetry and monitoring (gNMI/OpenConfig, SNMP, sFlow/IPFIX).
  • Knowledge of G PU cluster back-end network designs (rail-optimized and fat-tree Clos topologies), RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCEv2), lossless Ethernet mechanisms (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), congestion control and advanced load balancing (dynamic/adaptive load balancing and flowlet switching), and 400G/800G connectivity for AI/ML training and inference workloads
  • Relevant certifications such as JNCIP-DC/JNCIE-DC, CCNP/CCIE Data Center, or equivalent.

Individual Contributor (IC)

Understands customer deployment architectures, develops and executes comprehensive test plans, generates customer-consumable test artifacts such as reports and logs, and certifies software releases for customer-specific deployment scenarios.   • Proficient in Python and automation frameworks, with working knowledge of network testing tools such as Ixia and Spirent.

Who We Are
This role is part of the Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors, combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
Kinara was founded on patented technology developed during the founders Ph.D. research at Stanford University, with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinaras acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a dedicated AI accelerator and software group focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
The team has delivered two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume, supported by a mature and production-ready software stack, making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by marquee customers, including GAFA-class companies, a leading global e-commerce provider, and Tier-1 PC OEMs.
As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from world-class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access, while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler-driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real-world impact and long-term stability.
What We Do
We build game-changing edge AI solutions that enable faster, smarter, and more power-efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
At the core of our platform are Ara AI inference processors, purpose-built to deliver unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge. Paired with our comprehensive SDK and software toolchain, these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real-time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
Kinaras hardware-software co-design approach allows high-performance AI to be seamlessly embedded into edge devices, enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on performance, efficiency, and scalability, helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a leading role in its growth, delivering production-proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next-generation intelligent edge devices.
This is what you are responsible for
  • Implement compiler modules within defined subsystems: MLIR dialects, lowering passes, operator fusion strategies, and target code generation components for our NPU.
  • Participate in design and deployment of quantization flows and numerical-correctness verification for assigned features.
  • Develop and ship production-grade compiler passes and runtime integration components that are stable, debuggable, and performant.
  • Perform low-level optimizations and collaborate with kernel teams to address HW/SW performance gaps.
  • Contribute to compiler CI pipelines, test suites, profiling, and release processes.
  • Debug and root-cause performance and correctness issues on customer models; produce reproducible fixes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews.
  • Provide feedback to product and silicon teams on compiler-driven feature opportunities and tradeoffs.
Necessary Qualifications
  • 7-8 years of software engineering experience with hands-on compiler and systems work.
  • Experience with graph lowering, IR design, operator fusion, scheduling, and code generation for accelerators.
  • Strong systems programming skills -- proficient C++ and solid Python for tooling and infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping compiler components or systems software used in deployed products.
  • Solid debugging and profiling skills with common performance toolchains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with hardware architects and kernel teams.
  • Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team engineering practices.
Good to Have
  • Familiarity with MLIR-based frontends and dialects, such as TOSA, StableHLO, TorchMLIR.
  • Exposure to AI compiler stacks, hardware backends, or accelerator targeting.
  • Experience working with large-scale models or production ML inference pipelines.

title: Lead Technology Program Manager
jobDescription:
Powering the agentic revolution in travel. Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead Technology Program Manager to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.
In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large-scale programs.
The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Program Planning and Execution
  • Lead end-to-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
  • Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
  • Facilitate cross-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
  • Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results-oriented environment.
Governance and Communication
  • Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
  • Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
  • Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.
Risk and Dependency Management
  • Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
  • Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
  • Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.
Customer and Business Alignment
  • Support strategic customer initiatives and business-critical programs.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
  • Ensure business priorities are reflected in program planning and execution activities.
Continuous Improvement
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled program management best practices, tools, and processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
  • Contribute to organizational learning through lessons learned, retrospective reviews, and process enhancements.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Technology Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience leading large, cross-functional technology initiatives in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and technology delivery practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to decision making.
  • Experience managing program risks, dependencies, and executive communications.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting strategic customer programs, airline technology, travel technology, distribution platforms, or digital commerce solutions.
  • Experience working across globally distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks, Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery management tools.
  • PMP, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent project/program management certification.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced technology environment undergoing transformation and growth.
Success Measures
Success in this role will be measured by:
  • Delivery of committed program milestones and objectives.
  • Effective management of risks, dependencies, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Improved visibility and predictability of program execution.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in program governance.
  • Achievement of customer and business outcomes.
  • Contribution to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
Why Join Us
You will play a key role in delivering strategic technology and customer initiatives that drive business value and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to work with global teams, influence high-impact programs, and contribute to the successful execution of transformative technology initiatives.
Join us and help shape the future of travel through technology.
.

title: Associate Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Associate Technical Lead: 5+ yrs (Python, Docker, MLOps, Cloud platforms, LLM)
Mangalore - India FULL-TIME
A Little About Us
UniCourt is a leader in making court data more accessible and useful with our Legal Data as a Service (LDaaS). We provide real-time access to court data through our APIs and online app for business development and intelligence, litigation analytics, litigation tracking, case research, investigations, background checks, due diligence, compliance, underwriting, machine learning models, and process automation.
We provide access to court data from state and federal courts to a diverse list of clients, including Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw firms and industries such as legal, insurance, finance, investigations, government, education, nonprofits, and consumers.
UniCourt is a legal technology company focused on using technology to unlock the potential of legal data. We are based in both California and Mangalore, India and our team includes legal professionals, data scientists, physicists, computer engineers, and sales and marketing, professionals.
About the Job
We are seeking an Associate Technical Lead - AI/ML Engineering with a minimum of 5 years of experience in software development and machine learning. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and MLOps workflows, along with fluency in Python and containerized deployments.
This role involves active contribution to architecture and development, guiding a small group of developers, and working closely with the Technical Lead to deliver scalable AI solutions in production. The Associate Technical Lead is expected to balance individual contributor responsibilities with partial leadership, ensuring high-quality coding, strong collaboration, and technical innovation.
Our company creates some of the world s most cutting-edge software solutions in the legal industry. We solve difficult problems, work on innovative technology, and build world-class platforms for people and enterprises to interact with court records and other public data sets. With some of the best minds in the industry, we re one of the most sought-after learning and career destinations in the world of legal tech. If you re looking to work at a company with opportunities to forge your career path in technology, UniCourt is the right place for you.
Duties Responsibilities
  • LLMs AI Development
  • 1. Develop and deploy applications leveraging Large Language Models (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, DeepSeek, etc.).
  • 2. Contribute to fine-tuning workflows, prompt engineering, and inference optimizations.
  • 3. Collaborate with the Technical Lead on evaluating models for cost, performance, and scalability.
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • 1. Implement RAG pipelines by integrating vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.).
  • 2. Optimize embedding generation, retrieval accuracy, and domain adaptation.
  • 3. Support experimentation to reduce hallucinations and improve contextual grounding of responses.
  • MLOps Deployment
  • 1. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows using MLflow, Kubeflow, or equivalent.
  • 2. Contribute to model monitoring, logging, and retraining strategies.
  • 3. Collaborate with DevOps engineers to manage Dockerized deployments in cloud or on-prem environments.
  • Software Engineering
  • 1. Write clean, well-documented Python code following best practices.
  • 2. Build microservices for ML inference and data pipelines.
  • 3. Ensure secure, performant, and maintainable system designs.
  • Team Contribution Mentorship
  • 1. Mentor junior developers on coding best practices and ML workflows.
  • 2. Assist the Technical Lead with code reviews, time estimation, and task assignments.
  • 3. Support a team of 3-4 developers/engineers by providing guidance and technical problem-solving.
  • Innovation Research
  • 1. Execute Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) with new ML frameworks and open-source tools.
  • 2. Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and propose integration opportunities.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
Required Skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in Python software development.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs (fine-tuning, API integration, or open-source model deployment).
  • Practical knowledge of RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Solid experience in MLOps workflows including CI/CD for ML and monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of Dockerized deployments and microservices.
  • Experience mentoring or guiding junior developers.
  • Familiarity with AWS SageMaker or GCP Vertex AI (preferred).
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.
Nice to Have Skills Experience
  • Familiarity with distributed training frameworks (PyTorch Lightning, Hugging Face Accelerate).
  • Knowledge of data pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
  • Exposure to AI-assisted IDEs (GitHub Copilot, Cursor.io, Windsurf).

jobDescription:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
We are looking to hire a motivated Senior Developer proficient in front-end and back-end web development to join our dynamic global team. This person will be responsible for leading the design and development of Edwards SAPIEN X4S mobile application, a digital tool used by our field sales teams to facilitate patient procedural planning and case discussions regarding valve sizing. You will be tasked with the development from concept design working with various teams in RD, Marketing, Regulatory, Software Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, and Legal to develop new features, test app designs, and adhere to regulatory requirements, while ensuring quality control standards. If you thrive in horizontal collaboration, have a knack for designing scalable solutions, and are passionate about building solutions that align with emerging business needs, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a patient-focused dynamic environment.
How you ll make an impact:
- Lead design and implementation of features across iOS, and Android with a strong focus on correctly and faithfully rendering approved labeling content - from CSV/JSON datasets.
- Define and uphold engineering standards: testing strategy (unit/widget/integration), code review, static analysis (flutter_lints), and CI/CD.
- Drive release management - App Store / Play Store submissions, signing, versioning, build automation - coordinated with labeling release/approval cycles.
- Own and evolve the application architecture: navigation (go_router), dependency injection (get_it), offline data layer (drift/SQLite)
- Partner with Product, Regulatory Affairs, Labeling, and QA to translate approved labeling and requirements into a verifiable design, and to manage controlled content updates and translations.
- Implement UI screens and features in Dart and using Flutter SDK against established designs and patterns.
- Help implement and consume REST APIs (http) and handle authenticated sessions (JWT).
- Support localization so the app matches approved, translated labeling content
- Write unit and widget tests; fix defects found in test and review.
- Adhere to labeling/document-control practices - ensuring displayed content exactly matches the approved source and is properly versioned. Participate in code reviews and stand-ups.
- Document code and expected application behaviors
- Analyze, diagnose, and fix performance, functional software, and end-user issues
- Document and demonstrate solutions by developing technical documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code on moderately complex issues
- Determine and design medium to highly complex system specifications, standards, and programming including preparing and installing solutions within the scope of architecture, quality, security policies
What you ll need (Required):
- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent work experience and training in the specific technologies and programming languages that will be used for development required
- 5+ years of professional software development, including 3+ years deploying Flutter/Dart applications (or deep native iOS/Android experience with strong, demonstrated Flutter proficiency).
- Strong command of Flutter architecture patterns, state management, async/streams, and the package ecosystem (routing, DI, local persistence).
- Proven experience taking cross-platform mobile apps through the full lifecycle to store release.
- Solid grounding in REST API integration, authentication/security, and offline-first data design.

You will join a cross-functional team building our Next-Generation of digital signage tooling from a world class CMS that integrates design and event systems, through a multitude of signage presentation platforms, into high volume reporting, and analytics systems.

This role will help Digital Signage strengthen today s quality engineering foundation while evolving toward a more automated, telemetry-driven, and AI-enabled delivery model. We do not expect every future capability to exist on day one; we are looking for someone who can improve the current system while helping define and pilot the next generation of quality practices.
You will collaborate with Product, UX, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver high-quality features in an agile, flow-oriented delivery environment using Jira and CI/CD tooling such as GitLab CI/CD or Bitbucket Pipelines, across SaaS architectures including AWS and Azure.
The Person

You prioritize prevention of risk over late detection of defects, and you are comfortable coaching teammates, improving quality practices, and helping teams build quality into the platform from the start.   • Identify critical business journeys and create risk-based testing approaches.
  • Ensure functional parity between the legacy and modernized applications.
  • Define traceability between business requirements, test scenarios, test cases, automation, and defects.
  • Work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, architects, and DevOps teams.
Functional End-to-End Testing
  • Design and execute functional test scenarios for applications built using Angular and .NET.
  • Validate complex end-to-end business workflows across multiple applications and integrations.
  • Perform system integration testing across APIs, applications, databases, third-party platforms, and downstream systems.
  • Design regression suites based on business criticality and change impact.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and continuous regression.
API Integration Testing
  • Perform functional and integration testing of REST APIs and backend services.
  • Validate API contracts, request/response structures, business rules, authentication, error handling, and downstream integrations.
  • Build automated API validation suites using appropriate tools and frameworks.
  • Validate integration flows across AWS services and enterprise systems.
Database Migration ETL Testing
  • Validate migration of data from SQL Server to PostgreSQL.
  • Perform source-to-target data reconciliation and transformation validation.
  • Validate:
    • Record counts and completeness
    • Data accuracy and integrity
    • Data types and schema mappings
    • Transformation rules
    • Referential integrity
    • Duplicate and missing records
    • Null handling
    • Stored procedures and database logic
    • Historical and incremental data loads
  • Write complex SQL queries for data validation and reconciliation.
  • Identify data anomalies introduced during migration or transformation.
  • Develop reusable automated data validation and reconciliation utilities.
AI-Led Quality Engineering
  • Use GenAI and AI-enabled QE tools to accelerate:
    • Requirement analysis
    • Test scenario generation
    • Test case creation
    • Test data generation
    • Change-impact analysis
    • Regression optimization
    • Automation development
    • Defect analysis and root cause identification
  • Apply a human-in-the-loop approach to validate AI-generated testing artifacts.
  • Explore opportunities for intelligent test selection and risk-based regression.
  • Contribute to building repeatable AI-led QE patterns and accelerators for the modernization program.
Automation Continuous Quality
  • Develop and maintain UI and API automation frameworks.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve regression coverage and reduce manual testing dependency.
  • Collaborate with development teams to enable quality earlier in the SDLC.

  • Minimum 7+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering.
  • Strong experience in functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.

    • REST APIs

  • Hands-on experience in database migration, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
  • Experience working with SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as:
    • Playwright

    • Karate

  • Experience working in Agile delivery models.

Job Summary
Shape the Future of AI-Driven Pharmaceutical Product Development (PD)
In our pharmaceutical product development team at Bristol Myers Squibb in Hyderabad, we are focusing on building advanced and emerging GenAI, data science and engineering, and modelling approaches addressing complex challenges across chemical process development, biologics development, drug product development, and analytical development.
We are looking for an experienced professional (scientific manager - individual contributor) focused on advanced GenAI and data science capabilities, ideally with prior domain understanding and context of pharmaceutical product development and manufacturing. We seek talent who can critically challenge assumptions, frame the right questions, navigate ambiguity, and partner with AI to solve complex scientific problems related to pharmaceutical development.
This exciting opportunity sits at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation to help shape pharmaceutical development and build an environment where human expertise and AI work together to accelerate innovation, enhance productivity in pharmaceutical development, and help bring more robust and high-quality medicines to our patients faster.
What You Will Do
  • Partner with senior scientific functional leaders and scientists across Chemical Process Development, Biologics Development, Drug Product Development, and Analytical Development to identify opportunities where AI and GenAI can create transformative business impact.
  • Drive development of next-generation capabilities spanning GenAI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Knowledge Discovery, and Decision Intelligence.
  • Establish best practices for critical thinking, problem framing, and AI-enabled decision making.
  • Influence enterprise modelling strategy and investments across Product Development.
  • Mentor data scientists and AI practitioners in the team and build a culture that balances technical excellence with curiosity, courage, and collaboration.
  • Translate emerging GenAI capabilities into scalable products that generate measurable business outcomes and value.
What Makes You Successful
You understand that the most valuable skill in the era of AI is not model building, but problem framing, and critically probing problem statements, AI output, and assumptions. You should be comfortable with:
  • Challenging assumptions before accepting requirements.
  • Asking first-principles questions.
  • Navigating ambiguity and shaping incomplete ideas into meaningful next steps through collaboration with PD functions.
  • Building trust across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
  • Communicating complex concepts with clarity and executive presence.
  • Inspiring teams through influence rather than authority.
Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Data Science, Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in Data Science, AI/ML, GenAI, and Digital Innovation.
  • Demonstrated experience working in advanced innovation teams and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Deep expertise in Machine Learning, AI, GenAI with deep technical and hands on experience in the following areas:
  • Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning
    • Statistics, Supervised Unsupervised Learning, Bayesian Modelling, Probabilistic approaches, Cluster Analysis, Deep Learning, Time-Series Modelling, Causal Inference, Optimization
  • Generative AI
    • Large Language Models, Reasoning Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic Workflow Design, Multi-Agent Systems, Knowledge Graph Integration, LLM Evaluation Frameworks, Synthetic Data Generation, AI Safety Guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop AI Systems
  • Advanced Data Science Tools/Platforms
    • PySpark, Python, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, LangChain, LangGraph, MLflow
    • AWS, Databricks, Hugging Face, CI/CD Pipelines, Feature Stores, Vector Databases, Model Serving Frameworks
  • Strong track record of delivering business impact through data-driven solutions.
Preferred Experience
  • Domain understanding of pharmaceutical product development and/or manufacturing domain.
  • Agentic AI architectures.
  • AI governance and responsible AI frameworks.
  • Some prior exposure to hybrid mechanistic-AI approaches, physics informed ML
  • Contributions to building and scaling data science organizations.
With a single vision as inspiring as Transforming patients lives through science, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.
On-site Protocol
BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role.

FPGA Design Development:

  • Create timing-critical designs meeting stringent performance requirements
  • Implement advanced FPGA features including DSP blocks, block RAM, and high-speed transceivers
RTL IP Design Integration:
  • Design reusable, parameterizable IP cores for various applications
  • Develop custom interfaces including PCIe, AXI4, DDR memory controllers, and high-speed serial protocols
  • Create comprehensive IP documentation and integration guidelines
  • Collaborate with IP verification teams to ensure robust, production-ready designs
Embedded Firmware Development:
  • Develop embedded software for Zynq SoCs and microprocessor systems
  • Implement device drivers and low-level firmware for FPGA-CPU interfaces
  • Optimize software-hardware partitioning for maximum system performance
  • Work with real-time operating systems and bare-metal implementations
System Debug Validation:
  • Lead comprehensive FPGA system validation and verification efforts
  • Develop and execute test plans for complex digital systems
  • Utilize advanced debug tools including ChipScope, ILA, and hardware debuggers
  • Perform signal integrity analysis and timing closure activities
  • Troubleshoot complex hardware-software integration issues
Technical Leadership:
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on FPGA best practices
  • Participate in design reviews and architectural decisions
  • Interface with customers and stakeholders on technical requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in design methodologies and tools Qualifications
Experience Technical Skills:
  • 5-7 years of proven experience in FPGA design and development
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Xilinx FPGAs, including:
  • Zynq-7000 and Zynq UltraScale+ SoCs
  • Vivado Design Suite and associated tools
  • IP Integrator and block design methodologies
  • Strong RTL design skills with VHDL/Verilog
  • Embedded firmware development experience with C/C++ for ARM Cortex processors
  • System-level debug and validation expertise using industry-standard tools
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces (PCIe, DDR3/4 and NAND Flash)
Core Competencies:
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git, SVN)
  • Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Tcl, Bash)
Education Certifications:
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Machine learning principles and implementation on FPGA platforms
  • Experience with other FPGA vendors (Intel/Altera, Microsemi, Lattice)
  • Knowledge of AI acceleration frameworks and neural network deployment
  • Familiarity with high-level synthesis (HLS) for ML workloads
  • Experience with high-level synthesis tools (HLS)

Job Summary

Manager-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Digital Risk - Gurgaon/Mumbai/Bangalore

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of MA strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future - building a better working world for all.

Overview

CNS - Risk - Digital Risk :

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organizations ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence

  • Proficient in evaluating and implementing digital risk frameworks including AI Frameworks. Strong understanding of risk management principles and regulatory requirements in the digital landscape. Experienced in leveraging technical expertise gained from a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science or Computer Applications to analyze complex risk scenarios. Ability to utilize analytical tools and methodologies to assess and mitigate digital risks effectively. Capability to lead project teams in assessing and implementing risk strategies for clients in the CNS domain.
  • 7 plus years of professional experience in AI governance, technology risk, digital risk, compliance, or advisory roles, with direct exposure to AI-enabled or data-driven initiatives in large enterprises or consulting environments.
  • Hands-on delivery experience in AI governance, including AI governance framework development, AI risk policies, AI risk taxonomy, control definitions, governance operating models, and use-case-level AI risk and Responsible AI impact assessments.
  • Experience conducting AI governance and risk reviews across design, deployment, and operational phases, focused on governance oversight, assurance, and risk enablement, not deep technical testing or model development.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, AIGP, or equivalent AI governance credentials are strongly preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to produce clear governance documentation, client deliverables, and executive-level materials on AI risk, governance, and regulatory topics.
  • Proven stakeholder-management capability, with experience collaborating across business, legal, compliance, privacy, risk, security, and technology teams in a client-facing consulting environment.

Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

  • Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
  • Bachelor of Computer Applications

Experience

  • Artificial Intelligence (3+ years)

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary

Job Overview: We re hiring a Pre-Sales Specialist to build and run the outbound engine behind Datakrew s global growth. You will own a continuous, multi-geography pipeline engine and the qualification discipline that turns what it generates into genuine opportunities, supporting field sales across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia as the team grows. This is currently a single position, and the scope is designed to expand as the field sales team expands. You will be the connective tissue between marketing, field sales, customers, and the technical team, keeping a healthy, self-sustaining pipeline running in every market, not just the ones getting hands-on attention this week.

Own the outbound engine that builds Datakrew s pipeline across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities

What will you own from Day 1

  • Own and operate the automated, multi-geography cold outbound engine that builds and sustains pipeline continuously across regions, replacing one-to-one manual outreach with a repeatable, always-on system.
  • Qualify leads into genuine Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) by applying consistent qualification criteria before handing opportunities to field sales.
  • Partner with the Digital Marketing / Marketing Execution function to keep ownership clean: Marketing owns inbound demand-gen and MQL campaigns; this role owns targeted, account-level outbound and qualification into SQL.
  • Maintain CRM and outbound-tooling hygiene with accurate, up-to-date activity, account intelligence, and qualification data
  • Track and report pipeline generation volume, MQL SQL conversion, and deal velocity across all supported regions.

What this role grows into

As the field sales team expands across regions, the scope of this role expands with it. These become part of the remit as the pipeline engine matures and beds in:

  • Deep account intelligence (buying-committee mapping, competitive positioning, use-case fit) so field sales can run a consultative, insight-led process rather than a generic pitch
  • Techno-commercial proposals tailored to client needs, decision criteria, and business objectives
  • Coordination across customers, field sales, and engineering, with quick-turnaround customisation of proposals and decks as deals progress
  • Continuous learning of Datakrew s evolving technology and product offerings

Qualifications

Required skills:

  • 5-7 years in B2B pre-sales, inside sales, or demand generation, including at least 2 years hands-on building and running automated outbound campaigns. SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement. Experience in EV, automotive, or battery tech is a strong plus.
  • Depth in multi-channel outbound (email and LinkedIn) using email automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), covering list building, cadence design, copy testing, and deliverability. This is core to the role, not incidental.
  • Aptitude for account research and building actionable account intelligence (buying committee, competitive landscape, use-case fit). Depth here can be developed in the role.
  • Strong qualification discipline, able to apply consistent criteria to convert leads into genuine SQLs rather than pass volume downstream.
  • Working knowledge of software integration concepts, APIs, and hardware-software integration.
  • Strong techno-commercial acumen, able to translate technical concepts into business language and vice versa.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, with cultural adaptability across geographies (UK, Europe, Southeast Asia).
  • Comfort with outbound copywriting and A/B testing of messaging and cadence to improve response rates.
  • Ability to build repeatable process, this roles remit is designed to grow in scope alongside field sales as the team expands, so process discipline matters as much as individual execution
  • High ownership, quick learning, and comfort working independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multi-geography environment.

Good to have:

  • Prior experience engaging with EV OEMs, automotive fleets, or IoT platforms
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce) and data enrichment / prospecting tools(e.g., Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
  • Awareness of email deliverability best practices (domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC basics) and outreach compliance considerations (GDPR, CAN-SPAM) across regions, since this roles outbound engine spans UK/Europe and Asia.
  • Exposure to AI-driven analytics or SaaS-based platforms.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Python Backend Engineer to help build and scale MyKarb, Nirantaras AI-guided Life Cycle Assessment and Product Carbon Footprint platform. You will develop backend services, data pipelines, and applied AI workflows that guide users through complex sustainability assessments and connect product data with verified lifecycle datasets.

You will work with technology leadership, engineers, QA, product stakeholders and LCA specialists in a fast-moving product team. The role requires strong software-engineering judgement, comfort with ambiguous business requirements and ownership from technical design through production support.

This position combines production Python backend engineering with applied AI. The priority is building reliable APIs, rule-driven workflows, background-processing pipelines and grounded LLM capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Backend services and APIs. Design, build and maintain secure, scalable FastAPI services and REST APIs supporting MyKarbs LCA, PCF and EPD workflows.
  • Applied AI and RAG. Develop LLM and prompt workflows using structured outputs, retrieval, grounding, guardrails, evaluation and human-review paths where required.
  • Rules and auditability. Implement deterministic validations and rule-driven decision logic for standards, PCR/EPD requirements and other compliance-sensitive workflows, with traceable evidence and audit trails.
  • Background processing. Build reliable Celery-based jobs and distributed workflows with retries, idempotency, monitoring and failure recovery.
  • Data and performance. Design data models, optimise database queries, caching, latency, token use and computation cost across production workloads.
  • Engineering quality. Write automated tests, review code, document technical decisions and contribute to CI/CD, observability, security and production reliability.
  • Cross-functional delivery. Translate BRDs and inputs from domain specialists into maintainable technical solutions and deliver production-ready features in two-week sprints.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong hands-on Python backend development.
  • Production experience with FastAPI and modern Python practices, including typing, asynchronous programming, Pydantic and maintainable service architecture.
  • Experience designing and documenting REST APIs, authentication, validation, error handling and API versioning.
  • Strong database skills with PostgreSQL or another relational database, plus experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable ORM.
  • Experience with Celery and Redis, RabbitMQ or another task queue/message broker, including retries and failure handling.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-enabled applications using prompt engineering, structured outputs, embeddings, RAG, semantic search or vector databases.
  • Experience with automated testing using pytest, including unit and integration tests for APIs and data-processing workflows.
  • Experience with Docker, Git, code reviews and CI/CD, plus practical exposure to deploying and operating cloud-based services.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving ability across application code, databases, distributed jobs and external integrations.
  • Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with engineers, QA, product stakeholders and non-technical domain experts.
  • Genuine interest in sustainability, climate technology or ESG and willingness to learn the fundamentals of LCA and carbon accounting.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex or a comparable LLM orchestration framework.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for retrieval relevance, LLM output quality, hallucination control or human-in-the-loop review.
  • Experience with vector databases, search infrastructure or large catalogue-matching and ranking problems.
  • Experience with Pandas, NumPy or scientific/data-processing workloads.
  • Experience with application monitoring, structured logging, Sentry or similar observability tools.
  • Knowledge of microservices, distributed systems, infrastructure-as-code or Kubernetes where relevant to production deployment.

Location: Pune

Job Type: Full-time, Hybrid

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.


Were building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

Youll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

Apply Pass qualification(s) Join a project Complete tasks Get paid

We are seeking a dynamic Cloud SDET / Senior Quality Engineer with 7+ years of experience in test automation, framework development, API validation, and microservices quality engineering. The candidate should have strong knowledge of distributed microservices architectures and multi-cloud environments, particularly AWS and GCP. The role involves building scalable automation frameworks across Cloud/Backend APIs, Web, and Mobile platforms and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Work with cloud components including GKE/EKS, storage/S3, Redis, Pub/Sub, Kafka, compute, IAM, and container registries.
  • Implement contract testing and mock services for distributed microservices.
  • Use Coralogix and Grafana for monitoring, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation.
  • Support testing of cloud-connected devices, telemetry endpoints, and IoT workflows where applicable.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering and Test Automation.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling automation frameworks using Pytest/Nosetests.
  • Strong experience in API automation using REST/GraphQL.
  • Good understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and GCP.
  • Experience with Cloud/Backend API, Web, and Mobile automation.
  • Strong experience with Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience implementing automated sanity, smoke, and regression suites.
  • Experience with endpoint validation, service-to-service communication, and contract testing.

Good to Have

  • IoT domain experience.
  • Experience with Gatling/Scala or performance testing.
  • Exposure to Coralogix and Grafana.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor AI, ChatGPT, or Gemini.

Job Summary

Our team is on a mission to solve complex challenges for the millions of people we serve every day. We are looking for a talented Senior Product Designer to join our Consumer Experience team, specifically focusing on the Notifications Outbound ecosystem. This team is the primary voice of our brand, managing the end-to-end journey of how we reach users through email, SMS, and other messaging mediums to drive critical actions like review collection. You will take a leading role in this product area, collaborating with designers, product managers, and engineers to transform outbound communication into a seamless, high-value user experience.

  • Lead Outbound Strategy: Own the end-to-end design process for our notification systems, turning conceptual communication strategies into simple, elegant, and high-converting user journeys across email and mobile.

  • Measure Iterate: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to guide the UX from discovery through launch, with a heavy focus on measuring design impact through conversion metrics and user sentiment.
  • InfluenceMentor: Shape high-level product ideation to ensure we are building the right things.
  • You will also mentor junior designers and champion a user-centric, data-driven culture.

Must have skills that matter

  • 7+ Years of Experience: A proven track record in product design with a portfolio that showcases expertise in visual design, interaction design, and complex problem-solving.
  • B2b Saas experience .
  • Outbound Expertise: Experience or strong interest in designing for off-platform experiences (Email, Push, SMS) and understanding the nuances of communication design.
  • Impact-Driven Mindset: Deep knowledge of the product lifecycle with a focus on defining and tracking success metrics to prove the ROI of design interventions.
  • Technical Savvy: Proficiency in Figma and a growth mindset that embraces new technologies, including AI-assisted design and complex design systems.
  • Strong Communication: A proven ability to articulate the why behind your design decisions and navigate ambiguity with optimism and humility.
